articles.summary: German Chancellor Friedrich Merz faced growing pressure on his leadership ahead of state elections in which polls suggest his governing party will fare badly. In one region, his CDU party is barely above the threshold required to enter the state assembly, and it faces the prospect of falling to second in the capital , too. Eight state premiers, all from the CDU, backed Merz ahead of ballots being cast and Germany has little history of replacing chancellors mid-term. But moribund economic growth and his personal unpopularity have raised what once seemed an unlikely prospect for the CDU. “The party forgives its chairman a great deal — as long as he governs successfully,” a Handelsblatt correspondent wrote. “ The time for forgiveness is over .” — Prashant Rao

articles.summary: Left-wing streamer Hasan Piker said he "absolutely" wants to campaign for New York Rep. Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez if she runs for president in 2028 and said he has talked with AOC and her team, he said in the new episode of "The Axios Show." Why it matters: Piker, who has millions of followers online, has been a high-profile campaign surrogate this year for a new generation of left-wing candidates, and wants to do the same in 2028. Driving the news: Despite Piker's ambitions, some Democratic politicians have begun distancing themselves from him because of his controversial commentary. Abdul El-Sayed, Michigan's Democratic nominee for the Senate, campaigned with Piker during the Senate primary. But after Piker told Axios that he believed America's long history of attacks in the Middle East that have killed civilians made it worse than al-Qaeda "pound for pound," El-Sayed said he disagreed and that Piker didn't speak for his campaign. El-Sayed has said Piker won't appear with him in the final weeks of the race before the Nov. 3 election.
